title: Gần hay xa: is it walkable?

segments.script: [EN: Quick review. Say a group of ten —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: chục] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say hundred —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: trăm] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say thousand —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ngàn] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say who —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ai] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say what —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: gì] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say what is your name —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: bạn tên gì] [EN: Good.]
